description.en: Exports metadata-only DSH turn, model, tool, approval, retry, and error events to Tuning Engines for governed traces, policy evaluation, cost analysis, and Work Session review, with a disk-backed retry queue.
description.zh: 将仅含元数据的 DSH 回合、模型、工具、审批、重试与错误事件导出到 Tuning Engines，用于受管追踪、策略评估、成本分析与 Work Session 审查，带磁盘重试队列。
